PullRequest.Title: agentHost: honour .gitignore files when syncing skill folders
PullRequest.Body:
Refs #350502

Skill folders are synced to agent hosts in full, apart from `.git` and `node_modules`. When a skill keeps data next to its instructions (a cache it writes to, Python bytecode, generated output), all of it is copied to every remote agent host. The bundle nonce hashes every file, so any write to that data forces a full re-copy before the next turn can start. Over a tunnel, a large enough skill folder can stall the connection (see #350502).

### Change

When collecting a skill directory, `collectDirectoryFiles` now honours `.gitignore` files inside the skill: the root one and any in subfolders, each layered on its parent. The existing `.git`/`node_modules` exclusions stay as the base layer. Ignored files are neither copied nor hashed, so changing them no longer changes the nonce.

### Testing

- New unit test `excludes files ignored by .gitignore files in skill directories` covers root and nested `.gitignore` patterns, directory and glob patterns, and an unchanged nonce after editing an ignored file. It fails without this change.
- `scripts\test.bat --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/syncedCustomizationBundler.test.ts`: 62 passing.
- `pnpm run typecheck-client` and `pnpm run oxlint` on the changed files pass.
- End to end with a dev build connected to an agent host in WSL: a user skill with `.gitignore` excluding `cache/` and `*.pyc` (768 KB cache). The host materialized only `SKILL.md`, `.gitignore`, `scripts/run.py` and `references/guide.md`. After adding another cache file and sending a second message, the host kept the same plugin revision, with no re-copy.

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: Static tracing proves child negations bypass parent rules (ignoreFile.ts:130-136); existing IgnoreFile tests verify that behavior. The changed check gates recursion. Dependency-tree size and latency are unmeasured.
Findings.PerformanceResource: Directory resolve/readdir operations, child stat calls, matching-file buffers and hashes, and remote content reads.
Findings.PerformanceScaling: O(D + N) extra traversal per shared scope's debounced re-resolution for newly reachable dependency directories and entries, plus matching-file bytes. Filesystem operations are limited to 10 concurrently per bundler; upstream URI deduplication and scope sharing do not remove this within-skill work.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Increased session readiness latency and repeated filesystem I/O; larger buffers and remote transfers for matching dependency files.
Findings.PreviousBehavior: SKILL_DIRECTORY_IGNORE always pruned .git/node_modules at their roots. Only those root entries were statted; their descendants were neither traversed nor read, hashed, or copied.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: A skill .gitignore allowlist such as `*\n!*/\n!*.md` re-includes .git/node_modules directories, allowing recursive traversal and bundling of matching files.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: Added line 117 replaces the fixed SKILL_DIRECTORY_IGNORE check with the layered ignore check. Added line 144 makes that fixed exclusion a parent which child negations can override.
Findings.Title: Keep .git and node_modules exclusions non-overridable
Findings.Impact: Opening an agent session with a forwarded skill containing dependencies and a directory-negation allowlist now traverses potentially thousands of dependency entries, delaying readiness. Warm customization re-resolutions repeat the walk; included documentation also increases hashing, memory, and cold remote transfers.
Findings.Evidence: SKILL_DIRECTORY_IGNORE excludes .git/node_modules (line 31). IgnoreFile.parseIgnoreFile returns false for a child inclusion before consulting its parent (ignoreFile.ts:130-136). collectDirectoryFiles resolves each visited directory and stats every child before filtering (lines 98-125). _bundle reads and hashes accepted entries before checking the nonce cache (405-424). AgentCustomizationScope awaits bundling before initial resolution; session claim awaits that resolution (agentHostSessionHandler.ts:1304). AgentPluginManager copies cold/changed-nonce bundles (agentPluginManager.ts:151-164).
Findings.Recommendation: Keep SKILL_DIRECTORY_IGNORE as an independent non-overridable guard alongside the layered gitignore check. Cover `*`, `!*/`, and `!*.md` with a test proving excluded-tree descendants are not traversed or bundled.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: Reading and hashing ignored skill cache/build data defeated the content-nonce cache on data changes, causing a full remote bundle copy.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: Large generated data inflated bundle I/O and remote transfers; data changes delayed operations awaiting customization sync.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: Prunes skill-local gitignored data from traversal, hashing and copying, preserving the nonce when only ignored data changes.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: The base skill traversal collected ignored cache trees. _bundle reads/hashes all collected files before checking its nonce (head 405-424); changed cache bytes therefore caused AgentPluginManager's full copy (151-164). Head line 117 filters ignored paths instead. The added test edits cache/data.ndjson and asserts exclusion and an unchanged nonce. Copilot getAppliedCustomizations awaits pending sync (13332-13349).

Scenarios.Scenario: Initial customization resolution and first agent-session claim, with skill folders that have no .gitignore
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Scope collection awaits resolveCustomizationRefs and bundling before completing initial resolution; session claim awaits scope.whenResolved. Host customization snapshots await pending plugin sync before relevant launches/operations. Local agent metadata parsing overlaps bundling.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve each visited directory (provider stat and readdir), then stat each immediate child.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: D resolves and N child stats per bundle, unchanged. No .gitignore content read is issued when directory children contain none.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same traversal, root exclusions, and call count.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must finish before bundle content reads and initial scope resolution.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read included source files; rebuild the synthetic plugin in an in-memory filesystem on a new nonce.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: F source reads/B bytes each resolution; F sequential destination writes plus manifest on a new nonce, no destination rewrite on an unchanged nonce.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same content checks and in-memory materialization.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Read/hash completion determines the nonce and precedes returning customization refs.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: One logical copy per synthetic plugin revision, implemented as client resourceList/resourceResolve calls for directories and Base64 resourceRead calls for files, plus host filesystem writes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Cold or new-nonce copy transfers the included tree, approximately F content RPCs and O(D) directory/metadata RPCs. Warm identical refs can avoid publication entirely; a host nonce-cache hit avoids the tree copy.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same URI+nonce cache and transfer cardinality.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Pending client plugin sync is awaited by Copilot getAppliedCustomizations and operation snapshots.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Unique forwarded skill entrypoint URIs after AgentHostClientCustomizationsService's ResourceSet deduplication. Let D be visited directories, N their immediate entries in total, and F/B the included files/bytes; .git/node_modules remain pruned in this scenario.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Events are debounced for 50 ms per shared scope. bundleSequencer serializes bundles per authority. Two synthetic bundlers may run in parallel, each with a 10-operation limiter; scopes with distinct authorities can run independently. Host plugin sync is serialized per plugin URI; content RPC reads have a provider-wide limiter of 10.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new ignore-file cache or retained objects when no .gitignore exists. Client nonce reuse occurs after traversal, reads and hashes, so warm resolution repeats that work as before. Host cache uses URI+nonce and materialized-directory existence, retaining up to eight revisions per plugin and 64 total. Sessions sharing a scope reuse its bundle.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed hunks, scope resolution, session claim, nonce checks, copy implementation and RPC limiter were traced statically.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: No timings collected. Provider latency and skill sizes vary, but this scenario adds only a bounded child-name scan per directory.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression for skills without gitignores. No new subprocess or database boundary; MCP configuration remains serialization-only in the bundler.

Scenarios.Scenario: Root/nested positive .gitignore exclusions, including cold sync and re-resolution after only ignored cache/build data changes
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each directory's ignore file is read before its child-stat batch and recursion. Remaining content checks still precede scope completion. Cold remote materialization and any changed-nonce sync precede operations awaiting customization snapshots; unchanged-nonce ignored edits do not cause another remote revision.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read discovered .gitignore content through IFileService before traversing that directory.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: I additional reads per resolution; no speculative reads for absent ignore files. Included ignore files may still be read once more with bundle content.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No rule-content read during traversal; an ordinary .gitignore file was only read during the bundle content phase.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds one dependency per directory containing an ignore file, while allowing pruning of potentially much larger descendant trees.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Traverse/stat surviving paths, read/hash accepted contents and write a new in-memory bundle only on nonce change.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: D resolves, N child stats and F source reads, rather than also visiting and reading ignored cache/build descendants. Content bytes now exclude ignored data.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Walked every non-.git/non-node_modules descendant, read and hashed ignored generated data, and rebuilt the complete bundle when those bytes changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Smaller traversal and content phases reduce the work before initial resolution. Warm nonce comparison still requires surviving-file content checks.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Materialize a cold/new synthetic plugin revision through resource RPCs and host filesystem writes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One copy per new synthetic plugin nonce, transferring only surviving files. Ignored-data-only changes now cause zero fresh copies; previously novel cache contents produced new nonces and a complete tree copy.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Included ignored data in every fresh copy and forced a new revision when that data changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Reduces cold copy bytes and removes repeated transfers from the pending customization-sync path after ignored-only changes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: D surviving directories, N entries statted in those directories, I discovered non-symlink .gitignore files, and F/B surviving source files/bytes. Ignored directory descendants are not visited; ignored entries in visited directories are still statted.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing 10-operation limiter also covers the new ignore reads. Ignore read precedes child stats within a directory; separate directory branches and skills overlap. Authority sequencing, 50 ms scope debounce, scope sharing and host per-URI sequencing remain unchanged.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Ignore files are read/parsed afresh per resolution; if included in the bundle they are read again in the existing content phase. Glob parsing has its existing pattern cache. The unchanged nonce skips local rewrite, and unchanged refs avoid republishing. Host URI+nonce caching eliminates a repeated copy when only ignored data changes. Failed ignore reads fall back to parent exclusions; they do not introduce traversal that did not exist before for this positive-exclusion scenario.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: positive filtering, entry collection, content hashing, nonce reuse and host materialization were traced; added test assertions cover excluded files and unchanged nonce after an ignored edit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Ignore-file sizes and cache/build sizes are unmeasured. The extra I rule reads are required for the new behavior and do not alone establish an actionable regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: Concrete performance fix recorded through report_regression_fix with the introducing commit resolved by base blame. No separate finding for the bounded rule-reading overhead.

Scenarios.Scenario: Skill .gitignore negations re-include fixed .git/node_modules exclusions during initial and warm customization resolution
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The layered matcher controls recursion. Newly reachable descendants must be resolved/statted before content hashing and initial scope completion; session claim awaits that completion. Cold/new-nonce host copies then add transfer work to pending customization sync. Warm nonce reuse does not skip client traversal.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Recursively resolve/readdir and stat dependency and Git metadata trees formerly pruned at their roots.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Adds Ddep directory resolves and O(Ndep) child stats per debounced resolution; can reach thousands of entries even when only Markdown files are ultimately included.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Only the excluded root entries were statted; no descendant filesystem calls. The operations are existing, but the diff makes these resources newly reachable.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Increases initial readiness latency and repeats I/O during warm re-resolution.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read re-included dependency documents into buffers, hash their bytes, and retain/write them in the synthetic tree on a new nonce.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Adds Fmatch content reads and Bmatch allocated/hashed bytes per resolution; matching dependency changes can force a full synthetic-tree rewrite.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No excluded dependency files reached content reads, hashing or synthetic-tree writes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds work before nonce comparison and scope resolution.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Copy the enlarged synthetic plugin over client resource RPCs and write it on the host.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Still one logical copy per cold/new plugin nonce, but adds Fmatch Base64 content RPCs/Bmatch bytes and directory RPCs. Warm unchanged nonce avoids this copy, not the local dependency walk.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same logical copy omitted the entire .git/node_modules trees; the diff increases copy contents rather than adding a separate per-skill plugin copy.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Increases cold/new-nonce customization-sync latency awaited by operation snapshots.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A unique forwarded skill with an installed dependency tree and a directory allowlist such as `*`, `!*/`, `!*.md`. Additional Ddep directories and Ndep entries become reachable; Fmatch/Bmatch are matching dependency documentation files. Multiple sessions sharing the same scope do not multiply the bundle walk.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: 10 filesystem operations in flight per bundler with per-authority bundle serialization, not one operation for an entire dependency tree. Scope events coalesce over 50 ms. Host copies are per-plugin serialized, with content RPC reads limited to 10 across the provider.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The child IgnoreFile explicitly returns included before consulting its parent, defeating mandatory root pruning. Ignore rules are rebuilt per resolution. A warm nonce only prevents local rewrite/remote recopy after the additional traversal and source reads/hashes. Host cache continues to work for unchanged nonces but cannot prevent cold larger copies or newly changed dependency files from producing revisions.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: 0.98: IgnoreFile precedence and glob handling were inspected, existing tests confirm child negation overrides parent exclusion, and the changed check directly gates recursive traversal. Downstream reads, cache placement, shared scope ownership and remote copy paths were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Prevalence of directory-negation allowlists, dependency sizes and filesystem/tunnel latency are unknown. Severity is medium; the traversal regression is established independently of those magnitudes.
Scenarios.Verdict: One introduced boundary-fanout performance regression accepted at syncedCustomizationBundler.ts:117. Preserve the fixed exclusions as an independent non-overridable guard.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance-review pass over the full two-file inventory and all diff pages. Submitted one accepted medium-severity finding and one accepted internal regression-fix signal. Traced initial claim, warm re-resolution, positive ignored-data pruning and negation bypass, including deduplication, scope sharing, debounce, per-authority/per-URI sequencing, 10-operation/read limiters, nonce caches and filesystem/RPC copy boundaries. Static review; no measured durations.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
